description: Round 12 (TC-1702): Validates YAML frontmatter in prompt template files. Each prompt file uses YAML frontmatter + text body format.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this prompt does

required_variables.description: Variables that MUST be provided when loading this prompt. PromptLoader validates at load time.

optional_variables.description: Variables that MAY be provided. Missing optional vars are replaced with empty string.

strategy.description: LLM call strategy overrides for this prompt.

min_words.description: Minimum expected word count in output

api_whitelist_enforced.description: Only allow API names from the provided whitelist

code_from_snippets_only.description: Code blocks must come from snippet_catalog verbatim
